title: Cross-catalogue recovery with exact marginal-DTI emission
protocol_note: The prompt again supplies no delimited single method paragraph (repeat of IR-79-02/IR-79-41). This lane is self-assigned and declared here before any scoring. No archived lane is restarted; no previous raster is copied, renamed or re-placed.
hypothesis: Expert faults missing from the QFDB/INGENIOUS catalogue concentrate where amplitude-balanced potential-field edges (tilt derivative, multi-scale horizontal gradient) and catalogue-tip geometry indicate structure with weak or absent surface expression. A model fitted to those label-blind channels transfers to a fault population compiled by a *different* mapping campaign (SGMC), and the competition DTI is best exploited by exact marginal-DTI emission on that surface rather than a hand-set dot budget.
mechanism: 14 label-blind physics channels from training_features.tif (19 bands) + 4 channels derived only from the visible catalogue mask; HistGradientBoostingRegressor of the 300 m triangular kernel-credit target built from *other* inner component groups (3 px collar), one fit per fold; emission by gems57.emit.greedy_allocate (exact two-sided marginal-DTI test) with a fixed 37,654-dot NMS arm and a uniform arm as controls.
named_non_fault_mimic: Playa and lake-margin shorelines (Lahontan/Bonneville) and fluvial terrace risers produce the same amplitude-balanced gravity/magnetic edges and the same detrended-elevation steps as fault scarps; Quaternary basalt flows produce magnetic edges with no fault; the TIGER road network is a linear cultural feature that the elevation step channel can also see.
why_not_already_in_catalogue: The catalogue is a compilation of mapped Quaternary surface traces. A fault buried by basin fill has no surface expression to map, but it still truncates the gravity/magnetic gradient and offsets depth-to-basement. This population is systematically underrepresented in a surface-geology catalogue, which is exactly the failure mode the competition asks us to repair.

instruments.I1: QFDB/INGENIOUS catalogue hide-and-recover, buffered_whole_components_loqo_v2 (gems57.pooled-hide-v2), 4 folds x seeds 20 and 30; scored with the official DTI (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 3 px triangular kernel).
instruments.I2: Cross-catalogue recovery of SGMC fault components more than 3 px from the competition catalogue (label-blind instrument; SGMC is never a feature). Same DTI formula, per fold region. This is an EXTERNAL-PROXY measurement, not an organizer score and not a substitute for I1.

arms.A_xcr_greedy: greedy_allocate(surface, allowed=footprint minus catalogue, k_truth=visible catalogue mass in the scored domain, max_dots=150000)
arms.B_xcr_nms37654: placement.place(surface, allowed, budget=37654, spacing=3) -- matched to the H33 dot budget
arms.C_uniform: deterministic uniform random dots at the B count

leakage_canary: single-feature symmetric AUC on both instruments; max(AUC, 1-AUC) > 0.90 is leakage until proven otherwise and stops the lane before any score is trusted
promotion_gate: A must beat B and the uniform arm on I1 on both seeds, AND beat the canonical incumbent G79-THVC (0.1905 seed 20 / 0.1944 seed 30) on I1, with non-overlapping paired spatial-block 95% CI on at least one seed, AND pass both novelty stages. Otherwise the lane is a negative result and no weekly slot is spent.
stop_rule: 3 experiments maximum, 2 hours; no parameter search beyond the declared arms; no post-hoc threshold change; no retuning on I1.
